# Dispatch and transit

In-stock small items normally dispatch within two business days. In-stock furniture normally dispatches within five business days. After dispatch, zone A transit is usually two to four business days, zone B is three to six, and zone C is five to nine.

These are ranges rather than guaranteed arrival dates. Made-to-order production time is shown separately on the product record. Severe weather, access restrictions, and carrier disruption may change timing. Order-specific tracking must be handled by a manager.
